title: Allan Clarke - I Wasn't Born Yesterday Album Cover
coreRelationships: The central portrait is sharply focused and in full color, contrasting with the faded, sepia-toned background elements.
Torn paper edges create a collage effect, revealing layers of imagery and texture.
The primary subject's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, creating a thoughtful or distant mood.
The typography for the artist's name is bold and dimensional, standing out against the softer background.
reuseFormula: Recreate the layered portrait collage with torn paper effects and a sepia-toned background. Apply a bold, 3D outlined sans-serif for the primary text and a simple, flat serif for the secondary text, both centered in the top white border.
